title: Ensuring Seniors' Access to Polyclinic Care
what_it_is: Ensuring Seniors' Access to Polyclinic Care

sections.label: Walk-in slots for urgent patients
sections.summary: Polyclinics will set aside some slots for walk-in patients with urgent needs and for elderly patients, especially frail ones with mobility issues.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The polyclinics will set aside some slots for walk-in patients with urgent medical needs, as well as for elderly patients, particularly those who are frail and who have mobility issues.

sections.label: Appointment tranches and MOH data
sections.summary: Some polyclinics release appointments in tranches, which does not solve capacity constraints and may frustrate patients; MOH lacks the requested data.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Some polyclinics already adopted the practice of releasing polyclinic appointments in tranches.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: However, this does not solve the issue of capacity constraint and in fact may frustrate patients more if they are repeatedly unable to book appointments.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) does not have the data requested by Member Dr Tan Wu Meng.

sections.label: Polyclinic delays from COVID-19
sections.summary: A combination of factors includes delays in building and operationalising polyclinics due to the COVID-19 pandemic, some delayed up to two years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Sorry, I did not quite catch the second question.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: There is a combination of factors: there has been a delay in the building and operationalisation of polyclinics as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic; some of them delayed by up to two years.

sections.label: Increasing walk-in slot proportion
sections.summary: There is the possibility to increase the proportion of walk-in slots.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: For his first question, yes, there is the possibility to increase the proportion of walk-in slots.

sections.label: Balancing walk-in and pre-booked slots
sections.summary: A balance is needed between walk-in and pre-booked slots, left to polyclinic operational teams, and the speaker will work to optimise this balance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: If we went to a fully online system, indeed, the frustrations that Members in this House have highlighted will become worse.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, we need a balance: we need some walk-in slots and some pre-booked slots.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: This is left to the operational teams running the polyclinic to take into account their capacity, the services that they deliver, the demographics of their population.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, I take the feedback from the Leader of the Opposition and other Members of the House, and will continue to work with our cluster management and operational teams that run the polyclinics and see how we can optimise the correct balance of online appointments made ahead of time, same-day appointments and walk-ins.

sections.label: Telemedicine for polyclinic services
sections.summary: Telemedicine is being explored to improve the delivery of services from the polyclinics.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Indeed, we are exploring the use of telemedicine to improve the delivery of services from the polyclinics.

sections.label: Supporting polyclinic healthcare workers
sections.summary: The passage states that data tracking, appointment balance, and support for primary care practitioners and polyclinics will continue.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Indeed, we will continue to explore how we can track the data to inform our decisions on resourcing the polyclinics and have a balance between online appointments, walk-in appointments, and the behavourial incentives for patients to choose between them.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Dr Tan's question about supporting healthcare workers in polyclinics is important.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: They continue to deal with an increase in demand, both through the COVID-19 pandemic and beyond, and I do want to record our thanks for the work that our primary care practitioners and the teams that they work with, have put in to support our residents and citizens and we are trying to make sure that they are as much as possible provided with access to the resources within primary care.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We continue to try to support them by expanding the role of GPs, by expanding the role of CHAS clinics, by helping to make sure that we right site care within the primary care space, by providing training and staff and resources to be able to support the very important role that primary care plays in our health ecosystem.
